large_synthetic_corpus.note: a 16,995,840-byte container; 257 reads removed from one open. The small-document corpus is the right one for how often this helps and the wrong one for how much.

peak_memory.after: min(65536, longest contiguous run times sector size)

accepted_evidence.latency: no timing is claimed for the real corpus. On the large synthetic corpus this change is responsible for the whole of the measured open and list improvement, -7.40 to -13.23 percent p50 in both directions, because change 0568's worksheet component is zero for those selectors; measured with both changes in one binary and attributed by region.

known_gaps.difat_path: the expected-FAT-sector-count mismatch is only reachable past the header's 109 DIFAT entries and no corpus fixture has any DIFAT sector, so that check stays as untested as it was; the DIFAT loop is unchanged
known_gaps.small_sector_multi_piece: exercised through the MiniFAT loader rather than the FAT loader, because a 512-byte FAT run past the bound would need more FAT sectors than the header can express; both reach it through the same run reader
